## Boundaries

**Individual-site boundaries:**
- Sites 1–7: **East** — private property in Sy. No. 14/2; **West** — Allalasandra village
  boundary with Chikkabommasandra / private property in Chikkabommasandra village;
  **North** — the next higher site (Site N+1's khata); **South** — the next lower site
  (Site N−1's khata). Site 1's South = **Allalasandra Road**.
- Site 8: **North** — Tank/Park; **South** — Site 7 (khata 14/1/7); East/West as above.

**Amalgamated Schedule Property (Sites 1–8 jointly, 53,148 sqft):**
- **East:** Property in Sy. No. 14/2
- **West:** Chikkabommasandra and Allalasandra Village limit / private property in
  Chikkabommasandra Village
- **North:** Tank / Park
- **South:** Allalasandra Road

## Operative clauses (letters K–O in the OCR)

- **K** — Owners admit no objection to amalgamating Schedules A–G into one Schedule Property;
  property taxes to be assessed as **one** to obtain a **single khata**.
- **L** — Upon execution, Owners have the right to develop the property **jointly**, either
  themselves or through any developer.
- **M** — **Owners shall jointly execute the JDA along with general power of attorney** and
  other deeds as necessary for the joint development. *(This is the clause that anchors why
  GPA instruments sit alongside this deed.)*
- **N** — Owners will enter a **sharing agreement among themselves** re individual share in
  built-up area "based on their ownership or as they deem fit". **NO UDS FRACTION IS STATED
  ANYWHERE IN THIS DEED** — see the parent reference §8(b).
- **O** — Nothing constitutes a partnership, nor authority for one party to bind another.

## Why this deed matters for a GPA in Swaminathan's favour

1. It is the **source for Schedule A** of any GPA covering Plot Nos. 1–8 — the amalgamated
   extent and common boundaries come from the closing schedule above.
2. It is the **source for Schedule B** — Kankshita's own undivided share is her Sites 6 & 7
   extents plus their road shares, because the deed states no fraction (parent ref §8(b)).
3. It shows **V. Swaminathan has historically been the family's GPA holder** (all 7 parties),
   which is why a fresh GPA in his favour is the natural instrument for the family.
